_comment: Gmail organizer rules (scripts/gmail_organizer.py). Rules are tried top to bottom and the FIRST match wins, so a mail gets exactly one label. 'query' is ordinary Gmail search syntax. archive=true takes the mail out of the inbox once it is older than archive_after_days (it keeps its label and stays searchable; the automations search all mail, never the inbox). archive=false = label only, the mail stays in the inbox because a person has to look at it. Nothing is ever deleted or marked read. A mail the organizer already archived is never archived again, so moving one back to the inbox sticks.
_hub_comment: Every store Gmail forwards into the hub inbox. There each mail is labelled under the Gmail it was delivered to first (ZUHRA/<source>/<rule label>, matched with Gmail's deliveredto: search), and the hub's own mail under ZUHRA/mkamrankhan342/... source_names renames a source's folder; any inbox not listed uses its token name.

rules.label: Amazon/Account health
rules.query: from:amazon.com subject:("at risk of" OR "Action Required" OR "Take action" OR "Reactivate listings" OR "Performance Notification" OR "policy violation" OR "deactivat")

rules.label: Amazon/Cases
rules.query: from:(merch.service05@amazon.com OR seller-performance@amazon.com) OR subject:("CaseID" OR "CASE #")

rules.label: Money
rules.query: from:(payoneer.com OR revolut.com OR wise.com) -subject:"daily update on"

rules.label: Amazon/Cancelled
rules.query: from:amazon.com subject:("has been cancelled as per" OR "has been canceled")

rules.label: Amazon/Listings
rules.query: from:donotreply@amazon.com subject:("Listing Created" OR "New Product Success" OR "peak season")

rules.label: Zoro/Receipts
rules.query: from:do-not-reply@zoro.com subject:("Your Receipt for Order" OR "Sales Order")

rules.label: Walmart/New orders
rules.query: from:relay.walmart.com subject:"New Walmart Marketplace orders received"
